results.title: More than 83,000 evacuated as Typhoon Saudel floods coastal China
results.description: More than 83,000 people were evacuated from China’s Fujian province after Typhoon Saudel brought torrential rain, strong winds and extensive flooding to southern and eastern coastal regions. Schools were closed and transportation services suspended in several affected communities. In the tea-producing village of Jinxi, floodwaters reportedly caused a three-storey building to collapse.
